title_short: Who Gives ad · DR06 · Donor Note: David
headline: A Meta ad with one job: make a stranger join David and give. David gives because Watsi is transparent, the team is lean and effective, and his gift makes a direct impact.
story: David has given to Watsi since 2016. In 10 seconds of his own voice: transparency, a lean and effective team, and a direct impact in people's lives.
One ask on the end card: join in with David and give today.
do: Hook text “Why I give: the receipts.” on frame 1.
Who Gives card from 00:04 (after the hook and the receipt), never first. It says David.
A 2 s transparency-sheet screen recording on “transparency”.
Big moments for “transparency” and “direct impact”, one at a time.
End card with the down arrow.
dont: No patient B-roll under a donor voice. No pain, poverty or guilt.
No AI headshot. Real photo only if Mackinnon's is on the Slack thread.
No surname, company or city on screen. Don't re-voice the audio: light noise clean only.

checklist: Frame 1 is the hook text, not the Who Gives card.
The Who Gives card says “Hear from David” and “Watsi donor since 2016”. Never Dean.
The last caption ends “people's lives.” and both words are heard.
No surname, company or city anywhere.
Watsi with a capital W only; watsi.org lowercase.
One brand element at a time: hook, receipt, card, big words, end card.
End card lines in order, with the small arrow pointing down. No logo lockup, no donate button graphic.

decisions.b: The brief's ask names a dollar amount. Money stays off this page, so the ask is the end card's “give today” lines. Nick confirms the end card words with Sonam.
The hook text is first, the Who Gives card comes at 00:04. If Sonam's locked Who Gives style needs the card first, Atdhe decides.

client_note: Why this matters: this is a Meta ad for new donors. Watsi's tone is dignified and joyful, never guilt. Sonam asked for the “Join in with [Name] and give today” end card (25 Aug).
